key_point: A Pikmin song beat Pikmin itself
title: A Pikmin song beat Pikmin itself
caption: In Japan, Pikmin's ad song Ai no Uta outsold the game itself. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #pikmin #nintendo

instagram.caption:
The Pikmin commercial song Ai no Uta became a hit single in Japan and outsold the game it was made to advertise.

It is sung from a Pikmin's point of view: they get thrown, carried and eaten, but they keep following you anyway.

Many listeners, especially tired office workers, saw themselves in those little creatures. A tiny ad jingle became a top 10 song of the year.

Did you know Pikmin had a hit song?
